ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because the multipliers are positional: Diadem, Signal-Thread Spinner and Pardo's Lurking Spiderlings turn gaps and neighbours into a real slot puzzle each turn, and Past Master plus a Lurking Inner Guard makes a chain the designer only half lists.
ratings_why.distinct: Hiding in your own slot, knocks by adjacent deaths and Lids in the preview play unlike any current tribe, though 'safe and inactive until something dies' echoes the Oozes' Belly.

verdict_why: The v1 loops are closed and every chain now ends; further passes would change the flavour of the combos, not fix anything.

points.text: Past Master on a Lurking Inner Guard means each time the Guard Springs it Springs the next Lurker, and Corkhinge lets that happen twice; worth listing as a named line in the Open Lodge build so drafters spot it.
Corkhinge re-closing Lids delays The Worshipful Master, so the two top Spring cards pull against each other; that is a good decision, and a line saying so would help players read it.
The Patient side (Reader of the Minutes, Grit-Dresser) is plain stat feeding; one Patient card that changes what a long wait does when it finally Springs would give the wait build its own combos.
With Mabyn out every Lurker is Patient, so Ballot Clerk's two lines both pay every turn and the choice between them disappears late; fine as a reward, just note it.
Lurk could say in one clause that a Lurker's own Start of Combat effects still work under its Lid, since the Past Master line depends on it.

standouts.why: Off-tribe Start of Combat units firing twice is the best Johnny hook in the tribe.
Doubling only neighbours makes placement the whole game: Mother or Pardo beside Diadem, gaps for the summons.
Lurking Spiderlings are hidden knocks that set off further Springs as they die, a chain that builds itself.

weakest.why: Lowest-Attack Lurker gets stats; no decision beyond keeping it on board.
Flat Patient feeding with nothing to combo off.
A plain deathrattle body; it does its fodder job and nothing else.

flags.note: On an all-Lurker board every Lurker Springs at Start of Combat, so double-damage Cleave Spring attacks land before the enemy acts.
Re-closing after the Spring attack makes each Lurker untargetable again; with Wafer-Lid Sentry the board can trade almost for free.
Golden Master with Diadem and Corkhinge repeats summons and Tapwell or Pardo text several times; slots cap it, but the stat side needs a sim.
